# The Martian

By Weir.

- Lent my copy to Carla, ask for it back in Tuesday meeting.
- The middle part drags, the last third makes up for it.
- I would give it four stars out of five.
- The writing is clear and the examples are memorable.
- Quotes I marked are in the margin, transcribe them later.
- Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories.
- A good book for a long flight.
- Not as good as the previous book by the same author.
